title: Sir Roger Penrose & William Lane Craig • The Universe: How did it get here & why are we part of it?
summary: Physicist Roger Penrose and philosopher William Lane Craig discuss the origin of the universe on the Unbelievable? show. Topics include Penrose's three realms of reality, conformal cyclic cosmology and whether fine tuning points to a creator.
why: Pointed to for Penrose's own explanations of the Big Bounce and his three-worlds idea.

quote.text: this video might serve as a quick introduction to Penrose's three world idea for those interested.
